scope: Experimental typed Service graph and standalone receiver collector; no CNI or node-agent activation

change.keyLayout: request metadata48 followed by original incoming wire tuple16
change.behavior: Different Service or endpoint incarnations sharing a wire tuple retain separate index claims and allocate distinct visible reply tuples

reuseProbe.before: New Service request dropped with receiver row and index count1
reuseProbe.afterInterpreter: New Service request accepted with receiver row and index count2
reuseProbe.afterKernel: New Service request accepted with receiver row and index count2
reuseProbe.oldReply: Delayed old Service reply rejected at source
reuseProbe.newReply: New Service reply restored to the new VIP

limitations: No live guest, native socket, NodePort, IPv6, or actual CNI/agent profile proof
Receiver collector is not called by the node agent
Native socket and packet paths do not yet share the full ownership protocol
